name: Riesz.Moments.laplace_le_exp_of_fourth_moment
statement:
theorem laplace_le_exp_of_fourth_moment (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (v a t : ℝ) (hv : 0 < v) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (ha2 : a ^ 2 ≤ v / 2) (hat : a * t ≤ 1)
    (hsecond : expectation μ (fun ω ↦ X ω ^ 2) = v)
    (hfourth : expectation μ (fun ω ↦ X ω ^ 4) ≤ 4 * v ^ 2) :
    expectation μ (fun ω ↦ Real.exp (-t * |X ω|)) ≤
      Real.exp (-(a * t) / 32)

name: Riesz.Moments.laplace_le_exp_of_weight_ratio

theorem laplace_le_exp_of_weight_ratio (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ)
    (v lam C r b : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hC : 1 ≤ C) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrC : r ≤ C)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hbC : b ≤ 1 / (512 * C * Real.sqrt C))
    (hsecond : expectation μ (fun ω ↦ X ω ^ 2) = v)
    (hfourth : expectation μ (fun ω ↦ X ω ^ 4) ≤ 4 * v ^ 2)
    (hvlow : lam * r / (64 * C ^ 2) ≤ v) :
    expectation μ (fun ω ↦ Real.exp (-|X ω| / Real.sqrt lam)) ≤ Real.exp (-b * r)

name: Riesz.Moments.independent_sum_laplace
statement:
theorem independent_sum_laplace (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (W : Ω → ℝ)
    (hmean : expectation μ W = 0)
    (hvariance : 1 / 64 ≤ expectation μ (fun ω => W ω ^ 2))
    (hfourth : expectation μ (fun ω => W ω ^ 4) ≤
      4 * (expectation μ (fun ω => W ω ^ 2)) ^ 2)
    (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (good : Finset (Fin n)) (C lam b : ℝ)
    (hC : 20 < C) (hlam : 1 ≤ lam) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbC : b ≤ 1 / (512 * C ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)))
    (hgood : ∀ i ∈ good, 1 / C ≤ |a i|) (hcount : (good.card : ℝ) / lam ≤ C) :
    expectation (independentLaw μ n) (fun ω => Real.exp (-|weightedSum W n a ω| / Real.sqrt lam)) ≤
      Real.exp (-b * (good.card : ℝ) / lam)

name: Riesz.Moments.product_sum_fourth
statement:
lemma product_sum_fourth (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (ν : FiniteLaw Γ) (X : Ω → ℝ) (Y : Γ → ℝ)

    expectation (productLaw μ ν) (fun ω ↦ (X ω.1 + Y ω.2) ^ 4) =
      expectation μ (fun ω ↦ X ω ^ 4) +

lemma abs_mean_of_fourth {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (μ : FiniteLaw Ω)
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hsecond : expectation μ (fun x ↦ X x ^ 2) = v)
    (hfourth : expectation μ (fun x ↦ X x ^ 4) ≤ 4 * v ^ 2) :
    Real.sqrt v / 2 ≤ expectation μ (fun x ↦ |X x|)

name: Oscillation.bool_product_expectation
statement:
lemma bool_product_expectation (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) :
    expectation (independentLaw boolLaw n)
      (fun x ↦ f (sampleSpaceEquiv Bool n x)) = finAvg f

name: Oscillation.rademacher_abs
statement:
lemma rademacher_abs (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ i, a i ^ 2) / 2 ≤ finAvg (fun x ↦ |rademacherSum a x|)

name: Oscillation.rademacher_fourth
statement:
lemma rademacher_fourth (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun x ↦ rademacherSum a x ^ 4) ≤ 4 * (∑ i, a i ^ 2) ^ 2

name: Oscillation.rademacher_negate
statement:
lemma rademacher_negate {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin n → Bool) :
    rademacherSum a (fun i ↦ !(x i)) = -rademacherSum a x

name: Oscillation.rademacher_second
statement:
lemma rademacher_second (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun x ↦ rademacherSum a x ^ 2) = ∑ i, a i ^ 2

name: Oscillation.shifted_rademacher_abs
statement:
lemma shifted_rademacher_abs (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ i, a i ^ 2) / 2 ≤
      finAvg (fun x ↦ |d + rademacherSum a x|)

name: Oscillation.finAvg_eval
statement:
lemma finAvg_eval {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (i : ι) (f : α → ℝ) : finAvg (fun x : ι → α ↦ f (x i)) = finAvg f

name: Oscillation.halfDigit_mean
statement:
lemma halfDigit_mean (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (ξ : Bool) (k : Fin (2 * d)) :
    finAvg (fun s : Fin d ↦ endpointWeight (halfDigit d hd ξ s).val k.val) =
      rowMean d k + halfGain d k * boolSign ξ

name: Oscillation.halfDigits_finAvg
statement:
lemma halfDigits_finAvg {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (F : (Fin n → Fin (2 * d)) → ℝ) :
    finAvg F = finAvg (fun ξ : Fin n → Bool ↦ finAvg (fun ρ : Fin n → Fin d ↦
      F (fun i ↦ halfDigit d hd (ξ i) (ρ i))))

name: Oscillation.halfGain_left
statement:
lemma halfGain_left (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (k : Fin (2 * d)) (hk : k.val < d) :
    halfGain d k = rowMean d k

name: Oscillation.halfGain_nonneg
statement: lemma halfGain_nonneg (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (k : Fin (2 * d)) : 0 ≤ halfGain d k

name: Oscillation.halfGain_right
statement:
lemma halfGain_right (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (k : Fin (2 * d)) (hk : d ≤ k.val) :
    halfGain d k = 1 - rowMean d k

name: Oscillation.matrix_double_mean
statement:
lemma matrix_double_mean (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    finAvg (fun k : Fin (2 * d) ↦ finAvg
      (fun r : Fin (2 * d) ↦ endpointWeight r.val k.val)) = 1 / 2

name: Oscillation.rowMean_le_one
statement: lemma rowMean_le_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (k : Fin (2 * d)) : rowMean d k ≤ 1

name: Oscillation.rowMean_nonneg
statement: lemma rowMean_nonneg (d : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 * d)) : 0 ≤ rowMean d k

name: Oscillation.sum_endpointWeight_inside
statement:
lemma sum_endpointWeight_inside {d : ℕ} (k : Fin d) :
    (∑ r : Fin d, endpointWeight r.val k.val) = k.val + (1 / 2 : ℝ)

name: Oscillation.sum_halfGain
statement:
lemma sum_halfGain (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (∑ k : Fin (2 * d), halfGain d k) = (2 * d : ℕ) / (4 : ℝ)

name: Oscillation.endpointValue_update
statement:
lemma endpointValue_update {n : ℕ} (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ)
    (i : Fin n) (z c y : ℕ) :
    endpointValue χ (Function.update p i z) Y c y = endpointValue χ p Y c y +
      (χ i * (endpointWeight z c - endpointWeight (p i) c)) *
        (if Y i < y then 1 else 0)

name: Oscillation.endpointWeight_refine
statement:
lemma endpointWeight_refine {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (p c : ℕ) (r k : Fin b) :
    endpointWeight (b * p + r.val) (b * c + k.val) =
      if p < c then 1 else if p = c then endpointWeight r.val k.val else 0

name: Oscillation.gridOsc_perturb
statement:
lemma gridOsc_perturb {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (f g : Fin m → ℝ)
    (a b : ℝ) (h : ∀ t, a ≤ g t - f t ∧ g t - f t ≤ b) :
    |gridOsc hm g - gridOsc hm f| ≤ b - a

name: Oscillation.gridOsc_step_outside
statement:
lemma gridOsc_step_outside {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (f : Fin m → ℝ)
    (e : ℝ) (Y v : ℕ) (hv : v ≠ Y / m) :
    gridOsc hm (fun t => f t + e * (if Y < v * m + t.val + 1 then 1 else 0)) =
      gridOsc hm f

name: Oscillation.gridOsc_step_perturb
statement:
lemma gridOsc_step_perturb {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (f : Fin m → ℝ)
    (e : ℝ) (Q : Fin m → Prop) [DecidablePred Q] :
    |gridOsc hm (fun t => f t + e * (if Q t then 1 else 0)) - gridOsc hm f| ≤ |e|

name: Oscillation.gridPotential_refined_influence
statement:
theorem gridPotential_refined_influence {n K V m b : ℕ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hV : 0 < V) (hm : 0 < m) (hb : 0 < b)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (hχ : ∀ i, |χ i| ≤ 1) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ)
    (r : Fin n → Fin b) (i : Fin n) (r' : Fin b) :
    |gridPotential (K * b) V m hm χ (refinedPositions p (Function.update r i r')) Y -
      gridPotential (K * b) V m hm χ (refinedPositions p r) Y| ≤ 1 / (K * V : ℕ)

name: Oscillation.sum_blockOsc_update_le
statement:
lemma sum_blockOsc_update_le {n m V : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) (z c : ℕ) :
    |(∑ v : Fin V, gridOsc hm (blockValues χ (Function.update p i z) Y c v.val)) -
      ∑ v : Fin V, gridOsc hm (blockValues χ p Y c v.val)| ≤
      |χ i * (endpointWeight z c - endpointWeight (p i) c)|

name: Oscillation.sum_fin_indicator
statement:
lemma sum_fin_indicator (K p : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ c : Fin K, if c.val = p then a else 0) = if p < K then a else 0

name: Oscillation.sum_fin_mul
statement:
lemma sum_fin_mul {K b : ℕ} (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ c : Fin (K * b), f c.val) = ∑ c : Fin K, ∑ k : Fin b, f (b * c.val + k.val)

name: Oscillation.sum_gridOsc_step
statement:
lemma sum_gridOsc_step {m V : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (f : Fin V → Fin m → ℝ)
    (e : ℝ) (Y : ℕ) :
    |(∑ v : Fin V, gridOsc hm (fun t => f v t +
        e * (if Y < v.val * m + t.val + 1 then 1 else 0))) -
      ∑ v : Fin V, gridOsc hm (f v)| ≤ |e|

name: Oscillation.sum_refined_weight_change_le
statement:
lemma sum_refined_weight_change_le {K b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (p : ℕ)
    (r r' : Fin b) (a : ℝ) (ha : |a| ≤ 1) :
    (∑ c : Fin (K * b), |a * (endpointWeight (b * p + r'.val) c.val -
      endpointWeight (b * p + r.val) c.val)|) ≤ b

name: Oscillation.sum_sub_single
statement:
lemma sum_sub_single {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f g : ι → ℝ) (i : ι)
    (h : ∀ k, k ≠ i → f k = g k) :
    (∑ k, f k) - (∑ k, g k) = f i - g i

name: Oscillation.gridMax_end_comparison
statement:
lemma gridMax_end_comparison {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    (f : Fin m → ℝ) (a : Fin (2 * d) → Fin m) :
    ((∑ l : Fin (2 * d), f (a l)) +
      |f (a ⟨0, by omega⟩) - f (a ⟨2*d-1, by omega⟩)|) / (2 * d : ℕ) ≤ gridMax hm f

name: Oscillation.kernelWeights_variance
statement:
lemma kernelWeights_variance {n d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (hχ : ∀ i, |χ i| = 1) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c v : ℕ) :
    (interiorCount (2 * d) m p Y c v : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ i, (kernelWeights χ p Y c (representativeHeight (b := 2 * d) hm χ p Y c v) i)^2

name: Oscillation.maximizingIndex_spec
statement:
lemma maximizingIndex_spec {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (f : Fin m → ℝ) :
    f (maximizingIndex hm f) = gridMax hm f

name: Oscillation.representativeHeight_bounds
statement:
lemma representativeHeight_bounds {n b m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (χ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c v : ℕ) (l : Fin b) :
    v * (b * m) + l.val * m < representativeHeight hm χ p Y c v l ∧
    representativeHeight hm χ p Y c v l ≤ v * (b * m) + (l.val + 1) * m

name: Oscillation.representativeHeight_strictMono
statement:
lemma representativeHeight_strictMono {n b m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (χ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c v : ℕ) : StrictMono (representativeHeight (b := b) hm χ p Y c v)

name: Oscillation.representativeHeight_value
statement:
lemma representativeHeight_value {n b m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (χ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c v : ℕ) (l : Fin b) :
    endpointValue χ p Y c (representativeHeight hm χ p Y c v l) =
      gridMax hm (blockValues χ p Y c (v * b + l.val))

name: Oscillation.representativeKernel_eq
statement:
lemma representativeKernel_eq {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (y : Fin (2*d) → ℕ) (Y : ℕ) :
    representativeKernel y Y =
      (if Y < y ⟨2*d-1, by omega⟩ then 1 else 0) -
        (if Y < y ⟨0, by omega⟩ then 1 else 0)

name: Oscillation.representativeKernel_ge_one
statement:
lemma representativeKernel_ge_one {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (y : Fin (2 * d) → ℕ)
    (_hy : StrictMono y) (Y : ℕ)
    (hlo : y ⟨0, by omega⟩ ≤ Y) (hhi : Y < y ⟨2 * d - 1, by omega⟩) :
    1 ≤ representativeKernel y Y

name: Oscillation.representativeKernel_interior
statement:
lemma representativeKernel_interior {n d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c v : ℕ) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : i ∈ interiorIndices (2 * d) m p Y c v) :
    1 ≤ representativeKernel (representativeHeight (b := 2 * d) hm χ p Y c v) (Y i)

name: Oscillation.representativeKernel_nonneg
statement:
lemma representativeKernel_nonneg {d : ℕ} (y : Fin (2 * d) → ℕ)
    (hy : StrictMono y) (Y : ℕ) : 0 ≤ representativeKernel y Y

name: Oscillation.rowDifference_endpoints
statement:
lemma rowDifference_endpoints {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (χ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c : ℕ) (y : Fin (2*d) → ℕ) :
    rowDifference χ p Y c y = endpointValue χ p Y c (y ⟨0, by omega⟩) -
      endpointValue χ p Y c (y ⟨2*d-1, by omega⟩)

name: Oscillation.rowDifference_eq
statement:
lemma rowDifference_eq {n d : ℕ} (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ)
    (c : ℕ) (y : Fin (2 * d) → ℕ) :
    rowDifference χ p Y c y =
      -∑ i, χ i * representativeKernel y (Y i) * endpointWeight (p i) c

name: Oscillation.sum_two_halves
statement:
lemma sum_two_halves {d : ℕ} (f : Fin (2 * d) → ℝ) :
    (∑ l, f l) = (∑ l : Fin d, f (lowerHalfIndex l)) +
      ∑ l : Fin d, f (upperHalfIndex l)

name: Oscillation.averaged_endpoint_baseline
statement:
lemma averaged_endpoint_baseline {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c y : ℕ) :
    finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin (2 * d) => finAvg (fun k : Fin (2 * d) =>
      endpointValue χ (refinedPositions p r) Y (2 * d * c + k.val) y)) =
      endpointValue χ p Y c y

name: Oscillation.averaged_refined_weight
statement:
lemma averaged_refined_weight {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (p : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) (c : ℕ) :
    finAvg (fun k : Fin (2 * d) => finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin (2 * d) =>
      endpointWeight (refinedPositions p r i) (2 * d * c + k.val))) = endpointWeight (p i) c

name: Oscillation.half_averaged_rowDifference
statement:
lemma half_averaged_rowDifference {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c : ℕ) (y : Fin (2 * d) → ℕ)
    (k : Fin (2 * d)) (ξ : Fin n → Bool) :
    finAvg (fun ρ : Fin n → Fin d => rowDifference χ
      (refinedPositions p (fun i => halfDigit d hd (ξ i) (ρ i))) Y (2 * d * c + k.val) y) =
      -(∑ i, χ i * representativeKernel y (Y i) *
        (if p i < c then 1 else if p i = c then rowMean d k else 0)) +
      rademacherSum (fun i => -halfGain d k * kernelWeights χ p Y c y i) ξ

name: Oscillation.rowDifference_abs_gain
statement:
lemma rowDifference_abs_gain {n d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (hχ : ∀ i, |χ i| = 1) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ)
    (c v : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 * d)) :
    halfGain d k * Real.sqrt (interiorCount (2 * d) m p Y c v) / 2 ≤
      finAvg (fun r : Fin n → Fin (2 * d) => |rowDifference χ (refinedPositions p r) Y
        (2 * d * c + k.val) (representativeHeight (b := 2 * d) hm χ p Y c v)|)

name: Oscillation.averaged_child_weight
statement:
lemma averaged_child_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (r : Fin b) :
    finAvg (fun k : Fin b => endpointWeight r.val k.val) =
      1 - ((r.val:ℝ)+1/2)/b

name: Oscillation.averaged_half_weight
statement:
lemma averaged_half_weight (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (ξ : Bool) :
    finAvg (fun s : Fin d => finAvg (fun k : Fin (2*d) =>
      endpointWeight (halfDigit d hd ξ s).val k.val)) = 1/2 + boolSign ξ/4

name: Oscillation.finAvg_neg
statement:
lemma finAvg_neg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun x => -f x) = -finAvg f

name: Oscillation.half_averaged_child_difference
statement:
lemma half_averaged_child_difference {n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (χ : Fin n → ℝ) (p Y : Fin n → ℕ) (c : ℕ) (y : Fin (2*d) → ℕ)
    (ξ : Fin n → Bool) :
    finAvg (fun ρ : Fin n → Fin d => finAvg (fun k : Fin (2*d) =>
      rowDifference χ (refinedPositions p (fun i => halfDigit d hd (ξ i) (ρ i))) Y
        (2*d*c+k.val) y)) = rowDifference χ p Y c y +
      rademacherSum (fun i => -(1/4:ℝ)*kernelWeights χ p Y c y i) ξ

name: Oscillation.sum_digit_values
statement:
lemma sum_digit_values (d : ℕ) :
    2 * (∑ s : Fin d, (s.val : ℝ)) = (d:ℝ)*((d:ℝ)-1)

name: Oscillation.sum_gridMax_averaged_end_comparison
statement:
theorem sum_gridMax_averaged_end_comparison {d m : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hm : 0 < m)
    (f : Fin (2*d) → Fin m → ℝ) (a : Fin (2*d) → Fin m) :
    (∑ l : Fin (2*d), finAvg (fun k => f k (a l))) +
      |finAvg (fun k => f k (a ⟨0, by omega⟩)) -
        finAvg (fun k => f k (a ⟨2*d-1, by omega⟩))| ≤
      ∑ k : Fin (2*d), gridMax hm (f k)

name: Riesz.hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_condCentered_bounded
statement:
theorem hasCondSubgaussianMGF_of_condCentered_bounded
    {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} (hm : m ≤ mΩ) (d : ℝ≥0)
    (hX : Measurable[mΩ] X) (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ d)
    (hzero : μ[X | m] =ᵐ[μ] 0) :
    HasCondSubgaussianMGF m hm X (d ^ 2) μ

name: Riesz.hasSubgaussianMGF_centered_bounded
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_centered_bounded [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (d : ℝ≥0) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ d) (hzero : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF X (d ^ 2) μ

name: Riesz.hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_of_condCentered_bounded
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_of_condCentered_bounded
    (ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hadapted : StronglyAdapted ℱ Y)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ d i)
    (hzero : ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hcondzero : ∀ i < n - 1, μ[Y (i + 1) | ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Y i ω)
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (d i) ^ 2) μ

name: Riesz.integral_exp_le_of_centered_bounded
statement:
theorem integral_exp_le_of_centered_bounded [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (d : ℝ≥0) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ d) (hzero : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) ≤ exp (t ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)

name: Riesz.integral_exp_sum_le_of_bounded_increments
statement:
theorem integral_exp_sum_le_of_bounded_increments
    (ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (d : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hmeasurable : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (i + 1)] (Y i))
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ d)
    (hcondzero : ∀ i < n, μ[Y i | ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, exp (t * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Y i ω) ∂μ) ≤
      exp (n * t ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)

name: Riesz.integral_exp_sum_le_of_condCentered_bounded
statement:
theorem integral_exp_sum_le_of_condCentered_bounded
    (ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (d : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hadapted : StronglyAdapted ℱ Y)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Y i ω| ≤ d)
    (hzero : ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hcondzero : ∀ i < n - 1, μ[Y (i + 1) | ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, exp (t * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Y i ω) ∂μ) ≤
      exp (n * t ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)

name: Riesz.integral_exp_terminal_le_of_bounded_differences
statement:
theorem integral_exp_terminal_le_of_bounded_differences
    (ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ) (Z : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (d : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ)
    (hadapted : StronglyAdapted ℱ Z) (hstart : Z 0 =ᵐ[μ] 0)
    (hbound : ∀ i < n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |Z (i + 1) ω - Z i ω| ≤ d)
    (hcondzero : ∀ i < n,
      μ[(fun ω ↦ Z (i + 1) ω - Z i ω) | ℱ i] =ᵐ[μ] 0) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, exp (t * Z n ω) ∂μ) ≤ exp (n * t ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)

name: Oscillation.coordinateOscillation_finAvg_last
Oscillation.finAvg_exp_boundedDifferences
statement:
theorem finAvg_exp_boundedDifferences (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → α) → ℝ)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hf : CoordinateOscillation f d) (t : ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun x ↦ Real.exp (t * (f x - finAvg f))) ≤
      Real.exp (t ^ 2 * n * d ^ 2 / 2)

name: Oscillation.finAvg_exp_centered_le
statement:
theorem finAvg_exp_centered_le (f : α → ℝ) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hosc : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ d) (t : ℝ) :
    finAvg (fun x ↦ Real.exp (t * (f x - finAvg f))) ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * d ^ 2 / 2)

name: Oscillation.finAvg_exp_drift_le
statement:
theorem finAvg_exp_drift_le (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → α) → ℝ)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hf : CoordinateOscillation f d)
    (z s u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hmean : s ≤ finAvg f - z) :
    finAvg (fun x ↦ Real.exp (-u * (f x - z) + u * s - n * u ^ 2 * d ^ 2 / 2)) ≤ 1

name: Riesz.PointSets.Icc_zero_eq
statement:
lemma Icc_zero_eq (x y : ℝ) :
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ × ℝ) (x, y) = {p | 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ y}

name: Riesz.PointSets.abs_colorSum_le
statement:
lemma abs_colorSum_le (X : Finset (ℝ × ℝ)) (χ : X → ℤˣ) (R : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    |colorSum X χ R| ≤ X.card

name: Riesz.PointSets.badSet_measure_zero
statement:

name: Riesz.PointSets.good_event_of_bad
statement:
theorem good_event_of_bad (n : ℕ) (b ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hB : Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)).restrict (Set.Icc 0 1))
      {X : Fin n → ℝ × ℝ | ∃ χ : Fin n → ℤ, (∀ t, χ t = 1 ∨ χ t = -1) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |∑ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter
          (fun t => 0 ≤ (X t).1 ∧ (X t).1 ≤ x ∧ 0 ≤ (X t).2 ∧ (X t).2 ≤ y), (χ t : ℝ)| ≤ b}
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    ∃ G : Set (Fin n → ℝ × ℝ), MeasurableSet G ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ε) ≤
        Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)).restrict (Set.Icc 0 1)) G ∧
      ∀ ω ∈ G, (Finset.univ.image ω).card = n ∧
        ∀ χ : ↥(Finset.univ.image ω) → ℤˣ,
          ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            b < |(colorSum (Finset.univ.image ω) χ (Set.Icc 0 (x, y)) : ℝ)|

theorem all_shapes_bad_occupancy_le (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (n M h : ℕ) (cell : Fin h → α → Fin M) (bad : Fin h → Set α) (C lam : ℝ)
    (hC : 20 < C) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hM : 0 < M) (hn : (n : ℝ) = M * lam)

name: Oscillation.iid_interior_laplace
statement:
theorem iid_interior_laplace {n M : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hM : 0 < M) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (p : Option (Fin M) → ℝ) (hp : ∀ c, 0 ≤ p c)

    (∑ x : Fin n → Option (Fin M), productWeight p x *

name: Oscillation.interior_div_mod_iff
statement:

    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (block s L ℓ) f +
        2 * |mid (block s L (b - 1)) f - mid (block s L 0) f| ≤
      b * osc (Set.Ico s (s + b * L)) f

    ∑ ℓ : Fin b, osc (B ℓ) f +
        2 * |mid (B ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩) f - mid (B ⟨0, by omega⟩) f| ≤ b * osc J f

theorem sum_grouped_product {ι κ Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype Ω]

name: Riesz.uniform_average_grouped_product
statement:
theorem uniform_average_grouped_product {ι κ Ω : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (a : ι → κ) (F : (c : κ) → ({i : ι // a i = c} → Ω) → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : ι → Ω, ∏ c, F c (fun i => x i.1)) / (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι =
      ∏ c, ((∑ y : {i : ι // a i = c} → Ω, F c y) /
        (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card {i : ι // a i = c})
